policy: This gate asks the analyzer for its vocabulary. The predecessor scraped the analyzer's source with a regular expression and its `passed` condition was satisfied by an EMPTY list, so an analyzer that handled nothing would have passed; the regular expression is gone and the empty-vocabulary case is now check D.

checks.name: A. every type the analyzer acts on exists in the wired grammar
A2. a type is not in both DECLARED and PASSTHROUGH
A3. every declared type carries a reason
A4. every pass-through carries a reason
B. every node type seen in fixtures, probes and the corpus is classified
C. every type the grammar declares is accounted for
D. the declared vocabulary is not vacuous
E. the corpus census actually ran
checks.detail: 1200 corpus files, 4498693 bytes, 6 repos, 18 with ERROR nodes

checks.name: F. the fixture set is present and non-empty
G. one symbol per tree element and per tree attribute, per file
checks.detail: 12 sources, 39 elements and 40 attributes, all exact

declared.AttDef: a Property symbol plus a `contains` edge from the element it is declared for
declared.AttlistDecl: the element whose attributes are declared here
declared.Attribute: a property of its element, and the source of `references` / `imports` edges for its value
declared.EmptyElemTag: empty tag: carries the element Name and the Attribute list
declared.ExternalID: a file reference on a doctypedecl, entity or notation
declared.GEDecl: a general entity declaration: a Type symbol owned by the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
declared.NDataDecl: the notation an unparsed entity points at: a `contains` edge
declared.Name: the name-bearing leaf for tags, attributes, PIs, DTD declarations and notations
declared.NotationDecl: a notation declaration: a Type symbol owned by the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
declared.NotationType: the notations an attribute may carry: each Name leaf becomes a `contains` edge
declared.PEDecl: a parameter entity declaration: a Type symbol owned by the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
declared.PI: a processing instruction: a Module symbol owned by its enclosing element
declared.PITarget: the name-bearing leaf of a PI
declared.PseudoAtt: a pseudo-attribute of a StyleSheetPI / XmlModelPI
declared.PseudoAttValue: the value of a pseudo-attribute; `href` is a file path
declared.PubidLiteral: the public identifier inside a PUBLIC ExternalID
declared.PublicID: a file reference on a NotationDecl
declared.STag: start tag: carries the element Name and the Attribute list
declared.StyleSheetPI: a file reference: the PI spelling the `xml-stylesheet` external token produces
declared.SystemLiteral: the file path inside a SYSTEM ExternalID
declared.XmlModelPI: a file reference: the PI spelling the `xml-model` external token produces
declared.contentspec: the content model of an element declaration; each Name leaf becomes a `contains` edge
declared.doctypedecl: a Type symbol naming the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
declared.document: walk root; the root element is reached through the walk
declared.element: the document's structural unit: a symbol plus a `contains` edge from its parent element
declared.elementdecl: a Type symbol for a DTD element declaration; its contentspec is the content model
declared.prolog: container: XMLDecl, doctypedecl and the misc PIs/comments under it are dispatched from here

passthrough.CharRef: a numeric character reference, not a name
passthrough.DefaultDecl: the literal #REQUIRED / #IMPLIED / #FIXED value, not a name
passthrough.ETag: the repaired grammar rejects a mismatched end name, so the name adds nothing
passthrough.EncName: the encoding pseudo-attribute literal inside an XMLDecl, not a name
passthrough.EntityRef: a USE; the declaration is GEDecl / PEDecl
passthrough.EntityValue: an entity's replacement text, not a name
passthrough.Enumeration: wrapper over the Nmtokens of a DTD attribute type
passthrough.Mixed: `(#PCDATA|a|b)*` — the names are read from the Name leaves, not the wrapper
passthrough.Nmtoken: an enumeration member is a token, not a name
passthrough.PEReference: inside an internal subset a PEReference is a DeclSep — a separator, not a use
passthrough.StringType: the literal CDATA, not a name
passthrough.TokenizedType: the literal ID / IDREF / … token, not a name
passthrough.URI: the aliased body of a SystemLiteral; the edge target is the enclosing literal, and the LITERAL carries the edge line
passthrough.VersionNum: the version pseudo-attribute literal inside an XMLDecl, not a name
passthrough.XMLDecl: `xml` is reserved; version and encoding are not declarations
passthrough._intSubsetItem: hidden rule; the repeat that carries a subset's declarations and conditional sections
passthrough.children: the element content model; its Name leaves are the declarations that matter
passthrough.conditionalSect: an INCLUDE/IGNORE section inside an internal subset; walked through so the declarations it guards are reached
passthrough.content: an element's child sequence: walked through so each child element is reached; nothing on it is a name
